[NICE-TO-HAVE] On the empty ScansTab page, consider rendering the filter pill row (greyed out) for visual completeness; currently it's hidden until items.length > 0.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_scan.delete_scan: when application_id is set on the scan record but the application no longer exists (e.g., user deleted it earlier), the $pull update is a no-op — that's fine, but consider also handling the case where the scan was originally inserted with application_id of a different user (shouldn't happen since insert uses user['_id'] as filter, but defense-in-depth: filter is already {'_id': app, 'user_id': user['_id']}, so OK).

ScansTab.del() uses window.confirm() — works but is jarring. Suggest replacing with the project's existing AlertDialog pattern (already used elsewhere in account/) so the delete flow matches the rest of the app.

routes_scan.scan_history pagination: limit/skip come from query string but there's no Link header / 'has_more' flag — clients have to compute total - skip - limit themselves. Minor, but consider returning has_more: bool for cleaner FE pagination.
AssistCard.jsx and WhatsNextCard.jsx don't import PropTypes — that's correct because they have no props. Worth a one-line comment so future contributors don't add the import speculatively.

Project still on prop-types runtime validation. Long-term consider migrating to TypeScript for the new sub-components — the *.propTypes definitions are already type-shaped (oneOf, shape, oneOfType), so the migration would be mostly mechanical.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every documented testid renders, no PropTypes/console errors observed on /visa/us or /account?tab=scans

test_credentials: Mock OTP user: any email + 123456. Seeded admin: admin@wehive.co.in / Wehive@Admin2026.
seed_data_creation: Each test using DB seed inserts a TEST_-prefixed scan (and TEST_-prefixed application when applicable) using pymongo synchronous client and cleans up in finally. No production/seeded data is mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests in test_scans.py use pymongo (sync) — NOT motor — to avoid the 'future belongs to a different loop' error that motor produces under module-scoped fixtures with pytest-asyncio default policy. Reuse this pattern for any future backend tests that need direct DB seeding while using requests for the API call. The /api/scan endpoints sit under prefix='/scan' so the full URL is /api/scan/history and /api/scan/{id}. Scan response serializes _id as 'id' in /history (frontend depends on .id). The integration path 'premium upgrade → POST /scan/passport with placeholder image → see in /history' was NOT exercised because it would consume real Emergent LLM credits; instead, scans were seeded directly into the `scans` collection — equivalent coverage of the persistence + delete + cross-tenant-isolation contract. The application detail smoke (/account/applications/{id}) test had a flaky in-page-fetch error ('body stream already read') likely from React DevTools or service-worker double-reading the response — unrelated to the app, and Round 11 already validated this page renders correctly post-refactor.
rca_of_the_issue: No new bugs found in Round 12. The Round-11 'PropTypes is not defined' regression on /visa/* (mentioned in the request) is fully fixed: 0 console errors and 0 pageerrors observed when navigating to /visa/us. AssistCard.jsx and WhatsNextCard.jsx correctly omit the PropTypes import because they take no props.
